items.claim: Uros Medic uses really nice stabbing teep kicks with his lead foot.
items.quote: we did see Uros Medic use really nice TE kicks. We saw him, and he's a southpaw as well, so we saw him from the same close stance, use the stabbing TE kicks to the body with his lead foot

items.claim: Uros Medic has won all of his fights by stoppage.
items.quote: Eros Medic has won all of his fights by stoppage.

items.claim: Uros Medic has a 3-1 record against southpaws.
items.quote: Eros Medic is three- one against southpaws, I think.

items.claim: Uros Medic is not defensively responsible, especially when pressured back on a straight line.
items.quote: Eros Medic is not defensively responsible, especially if he's pressured back on a straight line.

items.claim: Everything in Uros Medic's striking game revolves around his left hand.
items.quote: everything in his game revolves around his left hand.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez has not fought many lefties in the UFC.
items.quote: when you go look at Daniel Rodriguez, he hasn't fought a lot of lefties in the UFC.

items.claim: Beneil Dariush is one of Uros Medic's training partners and cornermen.
items.quote: Eros Medic's main training partner is Benil Daruse, or I wouldn't say his main training partner, but that's one of his cornermen. That's one of the guys that he trains with.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez's best weapon is his jab.
items.quote: Daniel Rodriguez's best weapon is his jab.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez does a good job using his jab and establishes it well to lead and punctuate combinations.
items.quote: Daniel Rodriguez does a good job using his jab. It's not that he breaks the rules and circles hard into the power side, but he's just not always trying to cut off the lead foot and throw the left straight. I love the way that Drod establishes his jab
